The '''Battle of Byblos''' was a battle fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that occurred on<ref name="TNEGtD" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE-Byblos">{{CSWECite|I|99|Byblos}}</ref> [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]].<ref name="TNEGtD" /> It took part during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CloneWars" /> a conflict which spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Prior to the battle, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Republic [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] hijacked a work crew of [[SRT autonomous short-range transport|SRTs]], a type of industrial [[Droid/Legends|droid]], to sneak behind Separatist lines.<ref name="TNEGtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Byblos was mentioned in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'', a [[2006]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TNEGtD" />
